verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm Reflect auto-creates a new daily note every day for journaling, and shows this is the default capture surface — meetings, bookmarks, Kindle highlights, audio transcriptions, and deep-link commands all funnel into 'today's daily note' by default. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the daily note is pre-filled from a customizable template (docs show auto-population from integrations but don't detail a user-editable daily-note template) and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
